steps.text: Some changes are so slow we don't notice them — weathering and erosion reshape the land over a very long time.
Pick a place to explore — tap “Mountain”.
Weathering breaks rock into smaller pieces (by water, wind, and temperature); erosion then carries those pieces away.
River rocks get smooth and round, sea cliffs get carved back, mountains slowly wear down — all slow natural changes over thousands of years.
